name: How long does a typical kitchen remodeling project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen remodeling project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen remodel typically ranges from three to eight weeks, depending on the scope of work. Minor updates like refreshing cabinets, replacing tile backsplashes, and repainting run faster. Full renovations that involve custom framing, layout changes, subfloor repairs, and coordinated mechanical work take longer. At HH Remodeling LLC, owner Abraham Becerra manages project scheduling directly, coordinating internal finish carpentry, tile, and drywall work alongside licensed trade partners for plumbing and electrical to avoid unnecessary delays between phases.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most kitchen remodels take between 3 and 8 weeks, depending on whether the project involves simple cosmetic updates or extensive framing, electrical, and plumbing changes.
